speaker: DR. ARIN RAO
text: The signal is stabilizing. Just a few more seconds, and we'll have everything.

speaker: MIRA
text: Keep an eye on the gravity shear, Arin. We're getting a lot of data, but let's not push it.

speaker: MIRA
text: Arin, the warning lights are up. The gravity shear is climbing!

speaker: MIRA
text: The Core is Destabalizing! Arin, we have to abort!

speaker: DR. ARIN RAO
text: No! We need to finish the scan!

speaker: MIRA
text: Arin, get out! I'll try to shut the Core down!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: SEVEN YEARS LATER — VESPER RESEARCH FACILITY, COMA WARD.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: Seven years in a coma... and his memories are still deteriorating.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: His mind keeps returning to the same event. The Asterion incident.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: Doctor... the neural link is ready

speaker: DOCTOR
text: You're going into Dr. Arin Rao's subconscious.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: Find the missing memories. Recover the shutdown sequence.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: And whatever you do... don't trust everything you see in there.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: Neural interface connected. Synchronization at forty percent.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: NEURAL LINK ESTABLISHED. ENTERING MEMORY CONSTRUCT.
